attchmntText: DCW Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
DCW Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
DCW Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Further to our intimation dated October 26, 2026 and in terms of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors (the  Board ) of Company at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, have, considered and approved the proposal for:1. The Un-audited Financial Statements of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.      Accordingly, we are enclosing herewith: a) A copy of Un-audited Financial Statements of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and b) Limited Review Report of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, issued by M/ s. V. Sankar Aiyar & Co., Statutory Auditors of the Company.2. Buyback of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company having a face value of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two only) each ( Equity Shares  and such buyback  Buyback ), from all shareholders/ beneficial owners of the Equity Shares of the Company (other than the promoters and shareholders belonging to the promoter group of the Company), through the  open market  route, using mechanism for acquisition of shares through stock exchange, in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018
DCW Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Investors Meet

DCW Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
